home.aboutTitle: Specialists in strength, mobility and longevity
home.aboutP1: BONAFIT is not a conventional gym or a generic workout. We support people who want to stay active, strong, agile and independent.
home.aboutP2: We train movement and wellbeing with calm, precision and respect for your body. The aim is not to fit a mould: it is for everyday life to feel lighter.
home.aboutNote: Close support, inside and outside the session.
home.aboutImageAlt: Woman strength training with dumbbells at home
home.quote: “We do not train to add years. We train so every year is lived with more strength.”
home.slogan: Age is not trained. Strength is.
home.offerTitle: A plan built with you, not for just anyone
home.offerLede: One-hour sessions at your home, with a programme that adapts to how you feel today.

offers.title: Personalised sessions
offers.text: Workouts of about 55–60 minutes, designed for you. We recommend two sessions a week to progress steadily, without rushing.
offers.alt: Barbell and weight plates on a wooden floor

offers.title: Assessment and programme
offers.text: We start by listening, assess how you move and design an individual programme that evolves with you.
offers.alt: Person walking along a dirt path by the sea

offers.title: A body that supports you
offers.text: We work on strength, mobility, balance and functional movement, with close follow-up so every session has a purpose.

home.stepsTitle: No rush, and no need to be in shape to begin
home.stepsLede: Three simple steps to find out whether BONAFIT is right for you, with no commitment.

steps.title: We talk
steps.text: You tell us how you are, what you would like to regain or build, and what you have done so far.

steps.title: We assess
steps.text: We review movement, strength and mobility to build a realistic starting point.

steps.title: We train
steps.text: We design your programme and adjust it session by session, as your body responds.

home.complementsText: To look after tone, recovery and that sense of wellbeing you notice between sessions.
home.complementsImageAlt: Relaxing massage on a treatment table
home.longevityTitle: We do not sell hours. We look after the life you want to keep living.
home.longevityText: The value of a BONAFIT programme is not measured in sets or minutes. It is measured in autonomy, confidence and the freedom to move without age becoming a barrier.
home.longevitySlogan: More strength. More mobility. More life.
home.areaTitle: Near you, in a setting that invites you to look after your body
home.areaLede: We work in Bonalba and Mutxamel. If you live in a nearby town, get in touch: we will find a way to train without travel getting in the way.
home.areaNote: Not sure whether we cover your area? Ask us and we will tell you clearly, with no commitment.

home.faqTitle: What people usually ask before starting

faqItems.question: Do I need previous experience?
faqItems.answer: No. We start with a relaxed assessment and adapt every exercise to your starting point.

faqItems.question: Where do sessions take place?
faqItems.answer: At your home, in the Bonalba and Mutxamel area. We look for the space that works best for you.

faqItems.question: How many sessions do I need?
faqItems.answer: It depends on your goal. The usual recommendation is two sessions a week, with consistency and without rushing.

faqItems.question: Do you work with aches or injuries?
faqItems.answer: Yes, always in coordination with your physiotherapist or doctor when needed. We do not replace healthcare.

faqItems.question: What does the first session include?
faqItems.answer: A conversation about your history and goals, a basic movement assessment and a first taste of the training.
